purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: PRWORA State Reporting and Eligibility Architecture — 1996–2026
question: How did the September 1, 2026 OLC opinion change the State and knowledge perimeter, and what implementation, data and outcome joins remain unproved?
bluf: The September 1, 2026 OLC opinion is the newest object in a broader campaign reopening Clinton-era PRWORA interpretations. It changes the Executive Branch position from benefit-agency reporting to a participating State-wide component-agency duty and rejects the old formal-decision/final-order knowledge threshold. Existing SSA, DHS/SAVE, Federal Student Aid and State-benefit identity rails make the change structurally important, but no replacement procedure, Education-to-DHS join, State transmission or enforcement outcome is established through the cutoff.
evidence_cutoff_note: Primary statutes, OLC opinions, the 2000 interagency notice, HHS/HUD/Treasury rulemaking and guidance, Federal Student Aid, Education grant-servicing, Treasury DNP, OPM matching and DHS acquisition sources were checked through September 2, 2026. The new opinion is issued and prospective; replacement implementation and operation remain unresolved.
use_note: Covers the enacted reporting provisions, the withdrawn 1998 OLC opinion, the 2000 interagency implementation notice, the September 1, 2026 OLC reversal, the 2025–2026 PRWORA reinterpretation campaign, the federated identity and benefit architecture, the SAVE firewall, the Education/grant/payment interlock and exact implementation return gates. Reverify every post-cutoff guidance, State action, litigation and operation; no new State transmission or enforcement outcome is established.

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.public_machine_data: The public site contains the complete positively selected structured dataset. public_full_text is true; reading_url and data_url identify the canonical JSON object.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
